title: Lattice API Description
description: The typed contract between an app and its origin's RPC endpoint. Its hash is the manifest's api.schema. Request and response bodies are CBOR on the wire and are validated against these JSON Schemas by the host (before sending / before the app sees them) and by the server.

topics.description: Server push (see rpc.md, Topics). Each topic is a stream of messages from the server, all of one schema. The app subscribes by name through the host.

effect.description: Side-effect class. Hosts may retry 'read' once after a network failure and never retry the others. 'financial' and 'destructive' calls are surfaced to agents as requiring confirmation.

errors.description: Application error codes this method may return, beyond the standard ones in rpc.md.

message.description: Schema of every message on this topic. The host validates each one before the app sees it.

bodySchema.description: A JSON Schema (2020-12 subset) whose instances are the decoded CBOR body. Must describe an object. No bytes or non-string map keys in v0.1.
